product_summary: Website kip.co.in (Mumbai, Maharashtra — 211/212 Gold Crest Business Park, LBS Marg) presents itself as 'Contract Manufacturer & Specialty Chemical Distributor' and 'Exporter', since 2012, claiming 150 products, 30 export countries, 3000 customers. Five published catalogue sections: (1) Solvents, Resin Raw Materials & Paint Additives — adipic acid, dimer acid, isophthalic acid, neopentyl glycol, 2-pyrrolidone, acetone cyanohydrin, butyl acetate, butyraldehyde, isobutyraldehyde, propionaldehyde, dearomatized D-40/D-60/D-80, DS-300 PU solvent, diacetone alcohol, ethyl acetate, ethylcyclohexane, GBL, glyoxylic acid 50%, methylcyclohexane, melamine formaldehyde resin, silicone-modified epoxy and polyester resins, paint additives KHT 7822 / silicone-free defoamer / wetting-dispersing agent; (2) Specialty Chemicals — thiophene derivatives (2-acetyl, 2-bromo, 2-chloro, 2-nitro thiophene, thiophene 99.9%), indole and nitro indole, and a C6–C10 alpha,omega-diol series (1,2-/1,5-pentanediol, 1,2-/1,6-hexanediol, 1,8-octanediol, 1,9-nonanediol, 1,10-decanediol); (3) Home & Personal Care — conditioning quaternaries (BTAC, BTMS, BKC 50/80%, Polyquaternium 07/22/39, Silicone Quaternium 22, GHTC, stearamidopropyl dimethylamine), cosmetic actives and beads, disinfectant actives (PCMX, DCMX, OBPCP, TCC, glutaraldehyde 50%, DMDM hydantoin, CIT/MIT), emollients (C15-19 alkane, isododecane, PPG-15 stearyl ether), emulsifiers (polysorbate 20/80, PEG-7 cocoate, PEG-120 dioleate, HCO-40), preservatives (1,2-octanediol, 1,2-pentanediol, 2-phenoxyethanol, sodium benzoate), surfactants (CMEA, CDEA, CAPB, coco/decyl glucoside), glycerin, glycolic acid 70%, triethanolamine; (4) Textile Industry — TDA-6 mole ethoxylate, dye-transfer inhibiting agent, four branded softeners (Accosoft 501, Velvetol V8, Fabcare EQ 90, Stepantex TAS 100), softener thickener and KSIL HT 904. All items are listed as catalogue entries with no technical datasheets, no CAS numbers, no plant capacity and no shipment references on the pages read.
role_hint: trader / distributor with contract-manufacturing claims — the site self-describes as 'Contract Manufacturer & Specialty Chemical Distributor' and 'Exporter'; the catalogue is a resale-style multi-principal range (branded third-party softeners Stepantex/Accosoft/Velvetol, branded cosmetic beads 'ATL', branded actives 'Argenol'/'Aurumcare') which is a trader signature, while own synthesis is claimed only for thiophene/indole/diol derivatives. No manufacturing site, plant address or capacity is published — only an office address in Mumbai. Role should be recorded as manufacturer_trader (claimed) / trader (evidenced by catalogue), not as a pure manufacturer.
comment: HS comparison: PARTIAL. Of the four declared codes only 292419 is corroborated by the catalogue (cocamide MEA / coconut diethanolamide, amide class). 291511 (formic acid) is not present anywhere in the published range — no formic acid product line exists on the site. 292519 (other imides) is not corroborated by any listed product. 320611 (TiO2 pigment >=80%) is not corroborated — the site sells paint ADDITIVES and resin raw materials, not titanium dioxide pigment; the closest real lines are 382499 (additives) and 390920/390730/390799 (resins). So two of four declared codes (291511, 320611) look like wrong/legacy codes and one (292519) is unverifiable. Conversely, the declaration omits the bulk of the actual business: quaternary ammonium conditioning agents and disinfectant actives (292390, 293369, 292429, 293321), heterocyclic thiophene/indole fine chemicals (293499), the C6–C10 diol series (290539/290519), lactams and lactones (293379, 293220), non-ionic surfactants and glucosides (340213, 340241), solvents (291531, 291533, 291440, 290211, 290220, 290244), resins (390920, 390730, 390799) and formulated softeners/additives (382499, 380894). Industry label 'Нефтегаз и химия' (oil & gas and chemicals) is a misclassification: nothing in the catalogue is an upstream oilfield or oil & gas product — the real verticals are paints & coatings, home & personal care / cosmetics, textile auxiliaries and pharma/fine-chemical intermediates. Per project rule 3 the HS mismatch is NOT a rejection ground: company is retained, declared codes corrected to the actual product-based list above, verdict accepted_hs_corrected. Factuality: every product above is 'заявлено, не подтверждено' — the catalogue is a marketing listing with no CAS numbers, no datasheets, no plant, no capacity and no customs/B-L line was checked or found in this review; no evidence of actual export or domestic shipments was established here (out of scope for this role). Note also that the site carries placeholder/lorem-ipsum text ('Lorem ipsum dolor sit amet' in the Distributor/Manufacturer/Exporter blocks) and generic stock testimonials with foreign names, so the catalogue should be treated as unverified claims until a datasheet or invoice is produced. No PAN, CIN or registration data was researched per role scope — null.
